description: 晴れた日の海沿いのサイクリングロードで、3人の高校生が自転車旅行の途中に休憩している。中央では男子生徒が自転車のハンドルに取り付けたサイクルコンピューターと紙のルートマップを見比べ、次の目的地を確認している。女子生徒の一人はベンチのそばで水筒から水を飲みながらヘルメットのストラップを調整している。もう一人の女子生徒は海を背景にスマートフォンで景色を撮影している。周囲には青い海、防波堤、サイクリング標識、休憩ベンチ、自転車3台、ヘルメット、バックパックなどがあり、3人が安全にサイクリングを続ける準備をしている。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show exactly three teenage students taking a short break during a cycling trip on a beautiful coastal bicycle path in Japan on a clear sunny day. Do not include any additional people. The atmosphere should be active, refreshing, safe, and positive. In the center foreground, a teenage boy wearing cycling clothes and a bicycle helmet is standing beside his bicycle. He is comparing a paper route map with a small bicycle computer or navigation device attached to the handlebars, clearly checking the next destination and route. His bicycle should have a small saddle bag and water bottle holder. On the left, a teenage girl wearing a helmet is standing beside a wooden rest bench. She is drinking water from a reusable sports bottle while using her other hand to adjust the strap of her bicycle helmet. Her bicycle is parked safely beside the bench. On the right, another teenage girl wearing cycling clothes and a helmet is holding a smartphone horizontally and taking a photograph of the ocean, coastline, and distant islands. Her bicycle is parked beside her. Include exactly three bicycles, one for each student. Surround them with rich but organized environmental details: a blue ocean, rocky shoreline, seawall, bicycle lane markings, a cycling route sign, wooden bench, three bicycles, helmets, backpacks, water bottles, a paper route map, bicycle computer, saddle bag, a small repair pouch, distant islands, green coastal hills, and a clear blue sky. The three actions must be visually distinct and easy to describe: one student checking the route, one drinking water and adjusting her helmet, and one photographing the scenery. Make bicycle safety equipment clearly visible. Clear foreground, middle ground, and background. Exactly three visible people. No additional people, no crowds, no animals, no speech bubbles, no captions required to understand the scene, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, highly detailed but uncluttered, expressive natural body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.

sentences.text: The three cyclists have paused along a scenic coastal route before continuing the next stage of their journey.
sentences.grammar: 現在完了形 / before＋動名詞
sentences.ja: 3人のサイクリストは旅の次の区間を続ける前に、景色の美しい海岸ルートで休憩しています。

sentences.text: The male student is consulting both a paper map and a handlebar-mounted navigation device to verify the planned route.
sentences.grammar: both A and B / to不定詞
sentences.ja: 男子生徒は予定ルートを確認するため、紙の地図とハンドルに取り付けたナビゲーション機器の両方を確認しています。

sentences.text: His posture suggests that he is determining the most appropriate direction toward their next destination.
sentences.ja: 彼の様子から、次の目的地へ向かう最も適切な方向を判断していることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: One of his companions is replenishing her fluids while readjusting the strap of her protective helmet.
sentences.ja: 同行者の一人は保護用ヘルメットのストラップを再調整しながら水分補給をしています。

sentences.text: The combination of hydration and safety checks indicates that she is preparing carefully before resuming the ride.
sentences.ja: 水分補給と安全確認をしていることから、彼女が走行を再開する前に慎重に準備していることが分かります。

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the third cyclist is using her smartphone to capture the picturesque shoreline and distant islands.
sentences.ja: その一方で、3人目のサイクリストは絵のように美しい海岸線と遠くの島々をスマートフォンで撮影しています。

sentences.text: She appears captivated by the expansive ocean view stretching beyond the seawall.
sentences.grammar: appear＋補語 / 現在分詞による修飾
sentences.ja: 彼女は防波堤の向こうに広がる壮大な海の景色に魅了されているようです。

sentences.text: All three students are wearing appropriate protective gear, suggesting that they are approaching the recreational activity responsibly.
sentences.ja: 3人とも適切な保護装備を着用しており、安全に配慮しながらレクリエーション活動を行っていることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how a cycling excursion can combine physical exercise, route planning, safety awareness, and appreciation of the natural landscape.
sentences.grammar: how節 / combine A, B, C and D
sentences.ja: この場面は、サイクリング旅行が運動、ルート計画、安全意識、自然景観を楽しむことを組み合わせられることを示しています。
